description: This file defines the ConvergenceException class used to indicate failure of convergence in numerical computations. It extends MathIllegalStateException and provides constructors to create instances with or without specific error messages.

classes.name: ConvergenceException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a numerical computation fails to converge to a finite value.

methods.name: ConvergenceException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a default localized message indicating convergence failure.

methods.name: ConvergenceException(Localizable pattern, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message pattern and arguments for detailed context.
